- Corner cells (4 total): degree 2
- Edge non-corner cells (24 total): degree 3
- Interior cells (36 total): degree 4

Each color class (black and white) has:
- 2 corner cells (degree 2)
- 12 edge non-corner cells (degree 3)
- 18 interior cells (degree 4)
